title_en: Provisions of the Supreme People's Court on the Jurisdiction of Cases of the Beijing, Shanghai, and Guangzhou Intellectual Property Courts

articles.content_en: Article 2 The Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court shall exercise cross-regional jurisdiction over the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions within Guangdong Province.

Article 3 The intermediate people's courts of Beijing Municipality, Shanghai Municipality, and the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court shall no longer accept intellectual property civil and administrative cases.
Other intermediate people's courts in Guangdong Province shall no longer accept the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions.
The primary people's courts of Beijing Municipality, Shanghai Municipality, and Guangdong Province shall no longer accept the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions.

Article 4 Where the subject matter of a case contains both the contents specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions and other contents, jurisdiction shall be determined in accordance with Articles 1 and 2 of these Provisions.

Article 6 The Intellectual Property Court shall hear appeals filed by a party against the first-instance civil and administrative judgments and rulings on intellectual property such as copyrights, trademarks, technical contracts, and unfair competition made by the primary people's courts in the city where the Intellectual Property Court is located.

Article 7 Appeals filed by a party against first-instance judgments and rulings made by the Intellectual Property Court and cases filed for review by the immediate higher court according to law shall be heard by the Intellectual Property Adjudication Division of the Higher People's Court where the Intellectual Property Court is located.

Article 8 The primary people's courts in the province (or municipality directly under the Central Government) where the Intellectual Property Court is located shall continue to hear the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions that have been accepted but not yet concluded before the establishment of the Intellectual Property Court.
Except for the Guangzhou Intermediate People's Court, other intermediate people's courts in Guangdong Province shall continue to hear the cases specified in Items (1) and (3) of Article 1 of these Provisions that have been accepted but not yet concluded before the establishment of the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court.
